info.title: Wayfarer player HTTP API
info.description: Target contract frozen by review of issue #47. This specification is not a claim of runtime conformance: see README.md and issue #50. Proposed surfaces are separate. HTTPS required outside loopback development.

get.x-authorization: Authenticated principal; list only current memberships.

Authenticated principal with unexpired single-use invitation token. Invalid/expired/revoked token returns generic 404. Redemption cannot elevate existing role.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque server-issued credential resolved to a principal. Never trust principal/role from input. Provisioning/login is outside this frozen slice.
